description: This file defines the 'Align' class and related classes/functions for aligning renderable objects in a console, including methods for left, center, and right alignment, and vertical alignment options, used within a larger console rendering project.

classes.name: Align
classes.description: A class that aligns a renderable object horizontally and vertically within a console output, handling spacing and style effects.

classes.name: VerticalCenter
classes.description: A deprecated class for vertical alignment of a renderable, maintained for backward compatibility but recommended to use Align with vertical='middle'.
